title: Find Two Non-Repeating Numbers
statement: Given an integer array nums in which exactly two elements appear exactly once and every other element appears exactly twice, return the two single elements as a list sorted in ascending order. Your solution must run in linear time and use only constant extra space (besides the two-element output).
hints: XORing all elements together cancels the duplicates but mixes the two unique numbers; you need a way to separate them.
The XOR of the two unique numbers is nonzero, so it has some bit set; that bit must differ between the two numbers, giving you a way to partition all numbers into two groups.

Isolate the lowest set bit of the total XOR with diff_bit = xor_all & (-xor_all), split nums into two groups based on that bit, and XOR each group independently to recover the two answers; sort them before returning.
